text: This pic is my only product photo, so it’s the one I need you to work from. I’m a little nervous about getting the listing images right when I only have one photo to start with. Keep my exact black bottle, and don’t add any branding or text. I’ve been overthinking this a bit, which is probably why I’m spelling everything out.
